Team —

Thanks for joining the calibration deep-dive this morning. A few items we need to resolve that couldn't be closed in the meeting:

1) Two tie-break cases (ENG-45, PL-12) where cross-team signal conflicts with manager recommendation — need a final adjudication and an action note for the HR file.
2) One sensitive personnel case flagged by People Ops — reviewer requests limited circulation and an audit trail.
3) Finalize matrix and lock ratings in Workday by Friday EOD (2026-03-27).

I attached my latest consolidated matrix (Q1_rating_matrix_v3.xlsx) and a redline on the sensitive-case note (sensitive_case_redline.docx). Please review the rows highlighted in pink and reply with final decisions or objections by EOD tomorrow.

Quick asks:
- Marissa: confirm the cross-team metric used to prefer peer signal over manager for ENG-45 and share the supporting snippet from the telemetry export.
- Vivek: if you still prefer the upward adjustment for PL-12, send a 1–2 line rationale we can include in the HR note.
- Kimberly: please confirm the limited-distribution language for the sensitive-case redline.

I want the final write-up to include: decision outcome, short rationale (1–3 sentences), and the person who will write the performance narrative.

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov

- Manager has documented improvement plan already in place (started Jan 2026) and the narrative should reflect progress but not a full bump.
